name: Location evidence confidence gate
purpose: Prevent BA/remote eligibility from being inferred from weak search snippets or marketing labels.

minimumEvidence: company career detail names BA-area worksite
job detail explicitly allows remote from Slovakia
worldwide/Europe remote detail has no Slovakia exclusion and no recurring distant-office obligation

quarantine: remote only appears in search-result snippet
hybrid is stated but office cadence/location is unclear
locationReason merely repeats the title without evidence
country eligibility is missing for a foreign remote role
only an aggregator/repost asserts remote while canonical detail is unavailable
reject: regular weekly or monthly commute to a distant city
conflictRule: Canonical job detail beats search index, repost and aggregator. Any unresolved conflict => locationEligibility=unknown and no active recommendation.
safeWriteRule: Never delete an existing active item solely because evidence is temporarily unavailable; quarantine on next substantive verification if conflict is confirmed.
